purpose: Counts of the identification stage of the literature search, before title-and-abstract screening. The later stages are counted by code/flow_counts.py from search_records.csv, revision/retrieval_frame.csv and revision/source_dispositions.json.
source: OpenAlex works endpoint, title_and_abstract.search, four queries (data/search_protocol.json), fetched 17 November 2026 (data/search_log.csv)

full_text_language_check.rule: A retrieved text fails if more than 20 % of its letters are kana, CJK ideographs or Hangul, or if fewer than 15 % of its Latin-script words are common English function words.
full_text_language_check.note: The three assessed reports (P27, P32, P35) had been entered in the study archive before the check was applied to every retrieved text; their comparisons were extracted from equations, figures, tables and English abstracts. The five set aside were never entered.
